# StationPlacement

`world-system`

Every station is an item: crafted (the first by hand, the rest at an earlier station), carried in the pack, placed from the hotbar and picked up again by its owner.

> No free stations and no shortcut keys: a station is made before it is placed (Phase 268)

## Attributes

| Field | Type | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ----------- |
| rules | json | Station placement table: { first, handInputs, pickUp, stations } (validated at fabric load) |

## Actions

### place

Place the station item in the selected hotbar slot at the aimed spot

**Conditions:**
- The host consumes one placement item and refuses without it
- The rotation travels with the request

### pickUp

Pick a placed station up again

**Conditions:**
- Only its owner, within reach
- The item goes back to the owner's pack
- A chest spills what it holds
